title: Lazy Days | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Lazy Days is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Come enjoy Lazy Days, a large Mediterranean-style home conveniently located just north of 30A in the heart of Seacrest Beach. This spacious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat sits on a large lot backing up to the golf course, providing ample privacy on this quaint cul-de-sac.Lazy Days accommodates up to 14 guests and offers private beach access through the deeded access just a few steps away. Located less than a mile from Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Watersound, you're just a short walk, bike, or drive from fun family activities at The Hub, fantastic restaurants, boutique shopping, and more.1st Floor:- 1st floor refrigerator for pool snacks!- King bedroom with TV/cable- Queen bedroom with TV/cable- Full connecting "Jack-and-Jill" bathroom with separate vanities- Modern bunk room: 3 sets of bunks + 1 large connecting bathroom with 2 showers - GREAT for kids!Outside:- Expansive outdoor living space with sound system- 16'x32' private pool with optional heating, lounge chairs, and outdoor shower- Fire pit area with seating2nd Floor:- Open kitchen and dining area, seating up to 8 at the table, and 4 at countertop- Living area with queen sleeper sofa, fireplace, TV, and seating for 4 at a game/dining table- North side outdoor deck with dining table and gas grill overlooking the pool - spiral staircase to the patio area- South side outdoor deck with Gulf views3rd Floor:- King master suite with chaise lounge and mini bar area with refrigerator- Master bath with double vanities, a glass enclosed double head shower, and jetted soaking tub overlooking the golf course- Balcony with sitting area overlooking the GulfWith over 1500 sq. ft. of exterior living, you and your family are sure to find comfort and luxury in this beautiful home just steps from the water!Additional Info for Lazy Days:- 4 Tommy Bahama Beach Chairs- 1 Tommy Bahama Beach Wagon- 1 Pack N Play- 1 High ChairPrivate Beach Access:Head down Pelican Glide and across 30A, turn right down the trail and at the Capistrano complex you'll find your deeded beach access.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 4 minutes walkingYour stay at Lazy Days comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Sorry, no pets allowed* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Parking for 4 cars (no garage access)A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
